# mtncloud_vdi_pool (Data Source)

Provides an MTN Cloud VDI pool data source: looks up a virtual desktop pool by name or ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_vdi_pool" "example_vdi_pool" {
  name = "Terraform Example VDI Pool"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the vdi pool
- `name` (String) The name of the vdi pool
